intro: When life gets busy, Fiona makes things easier. With its sleek design, hidden storage, and sturdy build, it’s the perfect mix of style and practicality, built to adapt to your needs. Our Superlatx mattress blends firm support with latex-powered comfort—cool, breathable, and built to help you sleep deeper, longer, and healthier every night.

features.title: Stylish and sleek—designed to impress
features.text: Featuring clean lines and a matte black finish, the Fiona Modular Bed exudes a contemporary charm that elevates your bedroom's look effortlessly.

features.title: Durable metal frame for long-lasting use
features.text: Built with a robust metal frame, this bed ensures enduring stability and strength, making it a reliable centerpiece for years of restful nights.

features.title: Space-saving without compromise
features.text: Designed to maximise functionality, its compact yet spacious layout fits seamlessly into smaller rooms while offering ample sleeping comfort.

features.title: Easy cleaning and maintenance
features.text: The elevated design and smooth surfaces make cleaning a breeze, letting you maintain a fresh and tidy space with minimal effort.

features.title: Natural latex comfort layer
features.text: The top layer gently adapts to your body, offering bounce, breathability, and pressure relief the natural way.

features.title: Hypoallergenic and dust-resistant
features.text: Safe for sensitive sleepers, it resists dust and allergens for a cleaner, healthier sleep every night.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
